title: Utility-Aware Data Pricing: Token-Level Quality and Empirical Training Gain for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.22893v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traditional ``row-count $\times$ quality coefficient'' approaches fail to capture the nonlinear utility of data for Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities. We present a utility-aware data valuation framework that moves from static accounting toward utility-based pricing. The framework combines token-level information density and data quality, empirical training contribution estimated by influence functions, proxy models, and Data Shapley values, and cryptographic mechanisms based on hash commitments, Merkle trees, and tamper-evident training ledgers. Preliminary evaluation includes a smoke-scale multi-domain study and a synthetic duplication test. Results show that proxy-based empirical gain achieves strong ranking agreement with proxy-defined realized utility and substantially outperforms row-count and token-count baselines in the tested setting, while the prototype provides a controlled sanity check of the valuation pipeline

translated_title: 面向效用的数据定价：面向大语言模型的令牌级质量与实证训练增益
translated_abstract: 传统的“行数×质量系数”方法无法捕捉数据对大语言模型（LLM）能力的非线性效用。我们提出了一种效用感知的数据估值框架，从静态核算转向基于效用的定价。该框架结合了令牌级信息密度与数据质量、通过影响函数、代理模型和Data Shapley值估计的实证训练贡献，以及基于哈希承诺、Merkle树和防篡改训练账本的密码学机制。初步评估包括一项小规模多领域研究和一项合成重复数据测试。结果表明，基于代理的实证增益在测试环境中与代理定义的实现效用具有很强的排名一致性，并显著优于行数和令牌数基线，同时该原型为估值流程提供了受控的合理性检验。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种效用感知的数据定价框架，结合令牌级信息质量、基于影响函数与Data Shapley值的实证训练增益估计以及密码学防篡改机制，实验表明其估值效果显著优于传统的行数计数定价基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a utility-aware data pricing framework that combines token-level information quality, empirical training gain estimation via influence functions and Data Shapley values, and cryptographic tamper-evident mechanisms, demonstrating substantial improvements over traditional row-count pricing baselines.
